pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
In this conversational lesson, I will help you feel comfortable talking about a very diverse range of topics! Conversational lessons will always be a mix of basic, surface level conversations and more complex, deeper conversations. 

Some examples of basic conversations: talking about everyday life, shopping at the supermarket, asking questions at the airport, etc.

Some examples of deeper conversations: current events, philosophy, economics, daily habits, etc.

For advanced learners, you will practice expressing your thoughts, ideas, and opinions in a clear and concise way. Lessons will have a combination of a structured and unstructured format, allowing you the ability to practice thinking on the spot, drive conversation, and debate about various topics. 

What can you expect? Advanced vocabulary, slang, and native phrases 
What materials do I use? Videos, articles, and podcasts which are accompanied by discussion questions
Which topics will be covered? Any and all! You will feel prepared to speak about any topic that may come up when communicating in English outside of class.

pro_course_detail.description:
Hi there! 

Whether you have a job interview in the government or in the private sector, I can support you to BE your best. I highlight the word BE because I believe the key to a successful interview is feeling confident and at ease, so that your authentic self and capabilities naturally come through.  

I worked eight years as a spokesperson for a U.S.government agency. I was interviewed hundreds of times for radio/TV shows and newspapers.  Looking back, it is hard to believe.  I am naturally an introvert and in my early professional years I could not sleep the night before a presentation. I took many trainings and learned many cognitive skills to cope with my nervousness.  However, what really helped me was learning about how the nervous systems works and simple, yet potent, practices to stay present in my body while connecting to others. 

In addition, I have interviewed hundreds of potential job candidates for U.S government positions.  The majority of the candidates I recommended were hired successfully.  I have a gift for aligning the right candidate with the right manager.  

I look forward to sharing my experience with you.   Here are some of the services I offer: 

•	Create customized interview questions based on your resume and the job description.  (If you would like me to create customized interview questions, please send me your resume and job description in advance.) 

•	Conduct a practice interview during which I will give you feedback on how to communicate verbally and non-verbally in a clear and confident manner.   

•	Enhance your vocabulary with Business English expressions.

•	Provide suggestions on how to answer "tricky" questions and what to ask. 

•	Help  you identify strengths that might not be apparent to you.  

•	Help you explore if the job is aligned with your experience, values, and goals.

•	Introduce you to some practices that will help you minimize your normal nervousness by staying connected to your body and the environment.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching method is as follows:

Step 1: Choose one sound to improve. There are 44 sounds in American English, and the most important to pronounce accurately are: the "R" sound, the "short i", and the "short a".

Step 2: Learn how to create the sound. Know what your tongue and mouth should be doing.

Step 3: Drill the sound with the IPA until it is comfortable.

Step 4: Learn the most common words that use your target sound. 

Step 5: Practice simple sentences using the most common words.

Step 6: Advanced practice (paragraphs, minimal pairs, tongue twisters etc).

Step 7: Test the sound again. Do you still need more practice?
